plain: So bad that it cannot be repaired or undone

webster.text: That cannot be repaired or mended; as an irreparable breach.

more.text: That cannot be recovered or regained; as an irreparable loss.

example.quote: What an irreparable loss would the British Jurisprudence have sustained, had the age of 50. been fixt there as the ultimate limit of capacity or readiness to serve the public.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 24, 1787
